    4. I understand that failure to comply with the inspection process may create a safety concern and may void the manufacturer’s warranty. The Contractor will seek to obtain signatures on these forms directly from the legal owner of the property or the legal owner’s authorized representative.

  12. I understand that all information collected in this Application, the home assessment, installation, and inspection is considered confidential information.
